info.title: API.SH: Sephora
info.description: The Sephora API from API.SH: public Sephora data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Sephora's search box suggestions for a partial query: suggested search terms, matching categories (id, name, link) and products (id, SKU, name, brand, shade or variant, price, list price, sale flag, rating, review count, size, image, link).

get.description:
The products of a Sephora (US) category or brand, 60 per page: name, brand, price, rating, review count, number of shades, badges (bestseller, new, exclusive, limited edition, online only) and image. Give `category` (an id such as cat150006, a slug such as skincare, or a sephora.com/shop/ link) or `brand` (a slug such as the-ordinary, or a sephora.com/brand/ link; `subcategory` narrows it to one of its categories). Also returns the category tree with product counts and `refinements`: every filter the site offers (brand, rating, skin type, ingredients, formulation and more) with counts; pass a value's `filter` back as `filter`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sephora-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (e.g. `cat150006`), slug (e.g. `skincare`) or sephora.com/shop/ link. Give this or `brand`.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand slug (e.g. `the-ordinary`) or sephora.com/brand/ link. Give this or `category`.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: With `brand`: only its products in this category id (see `categories` in the response), e.g. `cat150006`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A refinement filter from the response's `refinements`, e.g. `filters[Brand]=rhode`. Repeat the parameter or separate with `|`; values of the same refinement match any.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Glazing Milk Hydrating Ceramide Facial Essence
Le Chouchou Softening + Smoothing Peptide Daily Lip Balm

get.description:
A Sephora product: every shade or size with price and stock, rating, reviews and loves counts, description, how to use, ingredients, highlights, images and the review sentiment summary, the share of reviewers who recommend it (`recommended_percent` with the counts), the rating distribution, the number of shopper questions and the five most-answered questions with up to three answers each (all questions in /sephora/v1/questions).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sephora-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product id such as P510799, or pass `url`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Sephora product's shopper questions with their answers: question text and details, date, asker nickname, answer count and helpful votes, and each answer with its text, date, nickname, brand-answer and best-answer flags and votes. 50 questions a page with the total.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sephora-questions

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: A Sephora product id such as P510799, or a product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

questions.question: does it wear for a long time

get.description:
Reviews of a Sephora product, up to 100 a page: rating, title, text, date, author, recommended or not, helpful votes, verified purchase, free-sample and staff flags, the reviewer's traits (skin tone and type, eye and hair colour, age range, concerns), the shade or size reviewed, photos, videos and brand replies. Also returns the product's rating distribution, recommendation counts and the breakdown of reviewers by trait. Filter by rating, photos, traits, keywords and more.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sephora-reviews

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Sephora product id (P followed by digits) or a product link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only these star ratings, comma separated (e.g. `1,2`).

parameters.name: recommended
parameters.description: 1: only reviewers who recommend it; 0: only those who do not.

parameters.name: incentivized
parameters.description: 1: only reviews of free samples; 0: leave them out.

parameters.name: skin_tone
parameters.description: Reviewer skin tone value(s) from `stats.reviewer_traits.skinTone`, comma separated (e.g. `fair,light`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews that mention this text.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Beauty products for a search on Sephora (US): name, brand, price, rating, review count, number of shades, badges (bestseller, new, exclusive) and image, 60 per page, plus category counts (with subcategories of a selected category) and `refinements`: the filter groups the site offers for the results (brand, rating, finish, color family, benefits, ingredient preferences, size ...) with counts and the `filter` value to pass back. Narrow with `brand`, `rating`, `price_min` / `price_max`, `category`, `ingredient_preference` or any `filter`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/sephora-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only these brands: comma-separated brand names as listed in the Brand refinement, e.g. MAC Cosmetics.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-4 (e.g. 4 for 4 stars and up).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only results in this category: an id from `categories[].id`, e.g. cat140006.

parameters.name: ingredient_preference
parameters.description: Comma-separated ingredient preferences as listed in the Ingredient Preferences refinement, e.g. crueltyFree,parabenFree.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any refinement `filter` value from `refinements[].values[]`, e.g. filters[finish]=matte. Repeat the parameter or separate with |; max 20 filters in all.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
